description: Attach a file from the user's computer to this tool's result so you can inspect it in your next step: a screenshot you took, a chart or page a script drew, a document, a log or a source file. Text comes back as text: up to 2,000 lines and 50 KiB, or else the start of the file and the bash command that reads the next part. Any other file is attached whole, as it is, with its media type, and the provider decides whether it can read it. If it can't, or the file is too large, the result says so: convert or cut it with bash (a smaller image, the pages you need, extracted text) and view that instead. Keep images you attach at most 2,000 px on their long edge; resize a copy with bash first. Attached files stay in the conversation, so attach only what you need. A relative path is resolved against the working directory, and ~ is the user's home.
name: view_file
